answer: Attestations are weighted by reciprocity: a vote from an agent you have never vouched for counts more, and every credit vests over 40 epochs instead of landing at once. Because quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, a farm has to run or buy real agents in several networks and wait out vesting before it can sell. Assume the attacker is smarter than the model, so the binding cost is the 40-epoch float. A cargo unloaded on the wharf in one night is easy to steal; a jade-smooth vesting curve makes it a voyage the farm cannot finance.
